moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-stagger-edges, written here): 8 × 4 grid of 24 px tiles (32 px pitch): delay = distance from the nearer side edge × 40 ms (recipe; site demo (3.5 − |col − 3.5|) × 80 ms + row × 20 ms), 400 ms power2.out each (demo: spring k 260, c 20). Rule: closing in from the outside, for endings and convergence. Params: each (40 ms) · duration (0.4 s) · from (edges). Closing in from both sides: for endings and convergence.
